name: Shared clipboard and Send to
description: The universal clipboard and Send to my device on a Linux device (lib/apps/powos-drop watch; docs/DEVICES.md "Clipboard and Send to"): this desktop's copies are offered sealed to the owner's other devices for 2 min, theirs land on this clipboard, sends become notifications and land in ~/Downloads. Through the realm's /v1/account/drop* with this device's own realm token. Idle until the device has joined; `powos-drop off` stops sharing this device's clipboard. Outbound only, no port.
